slice: acceptance ledger and the integrated kill switch rehearsal

acceptance_ledger.note: These counts include this file's own X58 claim; the ledger is regenerated from the evidence directory, so a claim cannot exist without an artefact.

defects_found_and_fixed.what: DEL-01 exists under two plan sections and the ledger key collapsed them
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the ledger keys every case by its full manifest id and matches the registry on section plus test id

defects_found_and_fixed.what: module_gate takes a module key before the write flag, so the rehearsal dispatcher raised 42883
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: the module branch passes a real module key and the dispatcher reports any other SQLSTATE instead of dying

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the rehearsal asserted that no private_isg function is SECURITY DEFINER
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: fifteen definer functions are the deliberate client RPC boundary; the check now pins that exact set and proves no gate is among them

defects_found_and_fixed.what: the rehearsal expected the module switches to be closed by the phase switch
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: they are independent; the rehearsal now proves the phase switch refuses even with a module open, then closes both

not_proven: any of the 263 acceptance cases end to end
the sixteen old binary and new backend combinations (X03)
account deletion across the new domains (X56)
a restore drill measured for RPO and RTO in this slice (X57)
any store, panel, device or cross layer user journey
